newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israel to give Lebanon militia sophisticated arms.
newsitem.headline: Israel to give Lebanon militia sophisticated arms.

text.p: Israel plans to supply its Lebanon militia allies with sophisticated weapons to deter guerrilla attacks on Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the militia's Voice of the South radio said on Wednesday.
"The head of the Israeli liaison unit General Elie Amitay revealed that Israel plans in the coming period to supply the South Lebanon Army with sophisticated weapons," the radio said.
"These include night equipment in addition to TOW missiles that hit targets at a distance of 3,400 metres," the radio said.
Amitay spoke to Voice of the South during a visit to an SLA training camp in the town of Majidiyyeh near Marjayoun.
"The General also said that members of the SLA were undertaking training on the new weapons at training camps in Israel," the radio said.
Some 2,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong SLA police a 15-km (nine miles)-wide zone in south Lebanon. Hizbollah guerrillas frequently attack them in a bid to liberate the zone.
